source_caption:
I Love You, Beth Cooper is a teen romantic comedy about Denis Cooverman, a shy high-school valedictorian who surprises everyone during his graduation speech by confessing that he has always been in love with the most popular girl in school, Beth Cooper. Beth, played by Hayden Panettiere, unexpectedly shows up at Denis’s house that night with her friends to celebrate his graduation.

What follows is a chaotic night where Denis and his best friend Rich experience wild adventures with Beth and her friends while being chased by Beth’s angry ex-boyfriend. Through the crazy events, Denis gains confidence and Beth begins to see him differently, turning the night into an unforgettable coming-of-age experience.
